text: Travel experiences can be exciting and life-changing. Planning a trip is often as fun as the journey itself, because you have to choose where to go and what to see. When you visit a new country, you discover different cultures, traditions and ways of life. Trying local food is one of the best parts of travelling, as every dish tells a story about the place. Sometimes you face language barriers, but you can use gestures or simple words to communicate. In the end, the memories you make last forever, and you return home with amazing stories to share with your friends and family.
